title: The elder's coffer clearly gated itself in dialogue ('not open to asking... go hear what the dead king himself grieves over... then come back'), giving a concrete unlock condition. Other gated/teased content (the ivy-choked stone, the founding record's promised use-site) gave no equivalent signpost for what unlocks them, so they read as either broken or intentionally unreachable with no way to tell which.
